title: 挑战 1 · 两个 LED 串联
summary: 用一个电阻同时点亮串联的红色和绿色 LED。
concepts: Vf adds up 压降相加
description:
用 9V 电源点亮两个串联的 LED：+9V → 220Ω → 红色 LED → 绿色 LED → GND。

串联时 LED 的压降相加：1.8 + 2.1 = 3.9V，电阻上剩下 9 − 3.9 = 5.1V，粗算电流 5.1 / 220 ≈ 23mA。再算上每颗 LED 约 12Ω 的内阻（第 3 课讲过），实际电流约 5.1 / (220 + 12 + 12) ≈ 21mA。

思考：如果用 3V 的电源，两个 LED 还能亮吗？（不能：3V < 3.9V，达不到导通电压。）

figures.caption: 粗算：一圈走下来，各元件上的电压加起来等于电源电压。红 LED 要 1.8V，绿 LED 要 2.1V，两个先用掉 3.9V；剩下的 5.1V 落在电阻上，电流由它决定。
figures.alt: 电路图：9V 电池、220Ω 电阻 R1、红色 LED1、绿色 LED2 串成一圈。R1 上 5.1V，LED1 上 1.8V，LED2 上 2.1V，合计 9V。

en.title: Challenge 1 · Two LEDs in series
en.summary: Light a red and a green LED in series with a single resistor.
en.description:
Use a 9V supply to light two LEDs in series: +9V → 220Ω → red LED → green LED → GND.

In series, the LED voltage drops add up: 1.8 + 2.1 = 3.9V. That leaves 9 − 3.9 = 5.1V across the resistor, so the quick estimate is 5.1 / 220 ≈ 23mA. Adding each LED's internal resistance of about 12Ω (see Lesson 3), the actual current is about 5.1 / (220 + 12 + 12) ≈ 21mA.

Think about it: with a 3V supply, could the two LEDs still light? (No: 3V < 3.9V, which is not enough to turn them on.)

figures.caption: Rough estimate: going once around the loop, the voltages across the parts add up to the supply. The red LED needs 1.8V and the green one 2.1V, so the two take 3.9V first. The 5.1V left over sits across the resistor, and that sets the current.
figures.alt: Circuit: a 9V battery, a 220Ω resistor R1, a red LED1 and a green LED2 in one series loop. 5.1V across R1, 1.8V across LED1, 2.1V across LED2, 9V in total.

hints: LED1's short lead (cathode) and LED2's long lead (anode) must be on the same metal strip.
Both LEDs must point the same way: long lead toward the + side.
The whole circuit is a single path; don't connect the middle of it to a power rail.
LED1 的短脚（负极）和 LED2 的长脚（正极）要在同一条金属条上。
两个 LED 方向要一致：都是长脚朝 + 那一侧。
整个电路只有一条路径，中间不要接到电源轨上。
